related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

request.operation: inspect the compact accountability view for the selected session's recorded Environment owner passes
request.readback_timestamp_status: not-recorded; observed during this session before the owner outcome summary change

outcome.interpretation: The complete bounded scheduler-decision summary identified seven owners, but it exposed only scheduled/skipped counts. Response compaction retained one detailed owner result and omitted six details, so the compact per-owner summary did not expose the corresponding result and verification states.
outcome.scope_limit: This describes one selected-session recorded owner-pass execution. An empty readiness-service declaration does not establish that ambient services were absent or idle.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Compact owner-pass summaries omit per-owner result and verification states
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Add bounded per-owner counts for recorded result, scheduler-outcome, and verification statuses to the existing compact owner summary, preserving source coverage and avoiding fulfillment claims.

not_measured: Whether an agent needed any of these owner passes or received a useful result.
Whether compact omission required an agent to perform extra work.
Correctness or independent verification of the recorded owner results.
Recurrence across other sessions, traces, or response budgets.
